_comment: Tokens the library sets that the INSTALLED Material may not read, with the reason. 'replacedBy' maps a legacy token to the modern one; the audit then requires the modern token to be set AND read, so a legacy name can never be used on its own.

groups.name: legacy-material-19
groups.reason: Pre-v20 token names. Read only by Material 19.x (verified against 19.2.19, 4-12 reads each). Delete this group and the matching '// Material 19' lines in the SCSS when the minimum supported Material is 20.

groups.name: library-private
groups.reason: Variables owned by the library (read by its own snackbar wiring rules), not Material tokens. Their names are public API until 2.0.0.
